Title: @smoke Login page loads with all required UI elements
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://practice.qabrains.com/ecommerce/login; 2. Verify page heading 'Login' is visible; 3. Verify email input is visible; 4. Verify password input is visible; 5. Verify login button is visible; 6. Verify password toggle is visible
Expected_Result: Login page displays heading and all required form elements without error

Title: @smoke Successful login with valid credentials redirects to home
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter valid credentials from TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD env vars; 3. Click login button; 4. Verify URL matches base URL
Expected_Result: User is authenticated and redirected to home page at BASE_URL

Title: @smoke Invalid credentials keep user on login page
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter invalid credentials: wrong@example.com / WrongPass999; 3. Click login button; 4. Verify URL still contains /login
Expected_Result: User remains on login page and is not redirected to home

Title: Login page heading and all form elements are present
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Assert heading text 'Login' is visible; 3. Assert email input is visible; 4. Assert password input is visible; 5. Assert login button is visible
Expected_Result: All key UI elements are visible on the login page

Title: Logo click navigates to app landing route
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Locate header logo link with href='/ecommerce'; 3. Verify logo is visible and has correct href; 4. Click logo; 5. Verify URL
Expected_Result: URL navigates to /ecommerce route (or /login if app keeps unauthenticated users on login)

Title: Password show/hide toggle preserves value and toggles state
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Fill password field with 'Secret@123'; 3. Click toggle to show password; 4. Verify password value still 'Secret@123'; 5. Click toggle again; 6. Verify value still 'Secret@123'
Expected_Result: Password value is preserved across both toggle states

Title: Successful login redirects to home
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter valid credentials; 3. Click login button; 4. Verify URL matches BASE_URL
Expected_Result: User is redirected to home page

Title: Enter key in password field submits the login form
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Fill email field with valid email; 3. Fill password field with valid password; 4. Press Enter key; 5. Verify URL
Expected_Result: Login form submits and URL reflects /ecommerce route

Title: Keyboard tab order moves through all interactive controls
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Focus on email input; 3. Press Tab; 4. Verify password input is focused; 5. Press Tab; 6. Verify toggle button is focused; 7. Press Tab; 8. Verify login button is focused
Expected_Result: Keyboard focus cycles through: email → password → toggle → submit in logical order

Title: Invalid email format shows validation error
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter 'notanemail' in email field; 3. Enter 'Password123' in password field; 4. Click login button; 5. Verify error message
Expected_Result: Validation error displayed indicating invalid email format

Title: @regression Empty email field shows required validation error
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Leave email field empty; 3. Enter 'Password123' in password field; 4. Click login button; 5. Verify error message
Expected_Result: Validation error displayed for required email field

Title: @regression Empty password field shows required validation error
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter 'test@example.com' in email; 3. Leave password field empty; 4. Click login button; 5. Verify error message
Expected_Result: Validation error displayed for required password field

Title: @regression Invalid credentials keep user on login page without redirect
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter invalid credentials wrong@example.com / Wrong123; 3. Click login button; 4. Verify URL still contains /login
Expected_Result: User remains on login page after failed credentials — no unintended redirect

Title: @regression Email exceeding max length is handled safely
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Generate email of 260+ characters; 3. Fill email input; 4. Click submit; 5. Verify either input is truncated or validation error shown
Expected_Result: Input is safely truncated by the field or a validation error is shown; form does not crash

Title: @regression Password exceeding max length is handled safely
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Generate password string of 140 characters; 3. Fill email with test@example.com; 4. Fill password; 5. Submit; 6. Verify safe handling
Expected_Result: Input is safely truncated or a validation error is shown; form does not crash

Title: @regression Whitespace-only credentials are rejected
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter three spaces in email; 3. Enter three spaces in password; 4. Click login button; 5. Verify page URL
Expected_Result: User remains on login page — whitespace-only input is not treated as valid

Title: @regression Login API 500 error keeps user on login page
Preconditions: Login API is mocked to return HTTP 500
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Mock POST login/auth endpoint to return 500 status; 3. Enter valid credentials; 4. Click login button; 5. Verify URL still on /login; 6. Unroute mock
Expected_Result: User remains on login page and is not authenticated when server returns 500

Title: @regression Email and password fields are initially empty on page load
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Assert email input has empty value; 3. Assert password input has empty value
Expected_Result: Both email and password fields are empty on initial page load

Title: @regression Login page loads within acceptable time
Steps: 1. Record timestamp before page.goto(); 2. Navigate to login page; 3. Wait for page to load; 4. Calculate elapsed time; 5. Assert elapsed < 10000ms
Expected_Result: Login page loads and all elements are ready within 10 seconds
